answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 39632 Country: India Title: I have a query about house rent allowance. My company approves a HRA of 62000. I reside in a rented house in Hyderabad with a rent around 4500 per month Question: I have a query about house rent allowance. My company approves a HRA of 62000. I reside in a rented house in Hyderabad with a rent around 4500 per month. I am basically from Nanded where my parents reside in a house owned by them. In the light of below fatwa, http://darulifta-deoband.org/showuserview.do?function=answerView&all=en&id=11589 We (me, my wife and my child) used to go to Nanded and reside there, sometimes my wife and my child used to stay for months to support my mother if my Bhabhi was not there. My parents are not dependent on me and self sufficient, even then I spend some money on them as and when required. So, can I make a niyah of giving house rent to them and include this money in my house rent. Alhamdulillah, I pay zakah fully and do not want to waste 22000 (amount of money I lose if I show my rent as 4500) to corrupt government. Answer ID: 39632 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 482/457/N=1433) You should only show to the company as much rent as you are paying for house. It is unlawful and haram to show the company more rent than the actual rent though you intend to help your parents by it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
